name: Creator
author: PyCmd
description: A tab of its own where code is built out of blocks instead of typed. Over three hundred and sixty blocks across Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Markdown: pick one, fill in its holes, stack it, nest it. Press Build to see the source it writes, and Save to put a real file in your workspace - which the editor opens, the Servers tab runs and the Pages tab serves like anything else you wrote by hand.
